character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Produce eight consistent directional game sprites of THIS EXACT redesigned compact military Titan mech shown in the reference. Preserve its new angular broad shoulder armor, olive and brass plates, vertical brass forehead stripe above two cyan eyes in a sealed dark visor, larger hexagonal cyan chest reactor, integrated forearm cannon with cyan muzzle lights, mechanical other hand, broad plated feet and rear power tanks. Rotations must reveal correct side and back details; no face or chest reactor visible from back. Full body within frame, transparent background, crisp detailed pixel art, no pilot, no muzzle flash, no scenery, no text.
